actual_result.interpretation: Bad targeted generalization, not90/95-percent repayment accuracy. MiniLM89.83% is a different Banking77 topic benchmark. All models are proposal-only and runtime-abstain regardless of some positive teacher diagnostic outputs. Calibrated selective teacher F1 is not equivalent to runtime permission.

TRAIN_failure_evidence.executed_probe: Read-only frozen features on86 TRAIN rows; normalized dot-product nearest nonself neighbour, no learned classifier/optimizer; no heldout rows/predictions newly opened.
TRAIN_failure_evidence.causal_limits: Every previous-context fingerprint retrieves its own group; these contexts repeat across descendants whose targets mostly remain identical. This demonstrates a shortcut opportunity, not proof of each weight attribution. Flat bag/hash features and one pooled MiniLM context vector do not explicitly separate current speaker acts from quoted/prior speaker content. No-context heldout advantage is exposed diagnostic evidence, not a new selected hyperparameter.
TRAIN_failure_evidence.optimization: Both students achieved TRAIN F1=1. Teacher TRAIN macroF1=.994709. Hard student final data loss.001175, distill.011574; final hidden saturation.005087/0.0. Therefore repeating epochs or claiming gross capacity underfit is unsupported. Initial regularizer gradients~8e-6 versus data gradients.126/.235; no regularizer-dominance evidence. Distillation transfers in-sample teacher predictions and can preserve the same family shortcut; fitting TRAIN teacher perfectly creates no new semantic evidence.
TRAIN_failure_evidence.objective_check: Frozen objective uses masked group-weighted positive BCE and normalized per-head denominators. fit scales global denominator by batch_size/TRAIN_size, a standard unbiased batch scaling under uniform row shuffle. Gradients correctly use weighted(sigmoid-y). This review found no demonstrated objective arithmetic bug; no unseen evaluation was used to select a fix.

next_source_head_experiment.purpose: Useful narrow publisher-semantics pilot independently of failing repayment heads; no alleged source-labelled consent model.
next_source_head_experiment.primary_dataset: 2088 NLU++ TRAIN rows, all retained original IDs/groups. Fresh seven source heads:affirm,deny,dont_know,change,cancel_close_leave_freeze,request_info,transfer_payment_deposit. First6 known2088 each; payment-topic known1417 only.
next_source_head_experiment.architecture: Frozen local MiniLM current-utterance384 -> fresh7 independent linear logits. No fabricated previous context and no B77 classifier weight transfer. Source domain determines supervision mask only, never an oracle runtime feature.
next_source_head_experiment.B77: Keep the existing measured B77 reference; do not spend the next experiment refitting7943 rows merely to remap topics. The408/271/125/86-row categories above are exact source-topic slices for later reporting, not repayment-label augmentation.
next_source_head_experiment.loss: Per-source canonical group a_i=1/(G*n_g). For each known head P=sum a*m*y,N=sum a*m*(1-y); q=min(5,max(1,sqrt(N/P))) from TRAIN only. L_j=sum a*m*[q*y*softplus(-z)+(1-y)*softplus(z)]/sum a*m*[q*y+(1-y)]. Mean trained L_j +.5*.01*mean(W^2); unknown masks exactly zero. No20-group auxiliary fitting floor.
next_source_head_experiment.optimizer: One fresh head, fixed seed20261011, Adam lr.01,batch128,max100 epochs,threads2. Freeze settings before any further evaluation. No distillation until this narrowly named teacher has actually demonstrated useful diagnostics.
next_source_head_experiment.timeout: Preserve incomplete status if total cap expires; no retry/GPU fallback. Existing exposed CAL/EVAL may later be evaluated once under frozen settings, never used for settings selection or claimed fresh qualification.

minimum_new_data_tasks.input: Pinned raw publisher sources behind the2088 retained NLU IDs, preserving original IDs/splits/targets. Existing v2 text is gold-entity-span-redacted; never use its REDACTED_ENTITY count/position as new label cues.
minimum_new_data_tasks.output_proposed: NEW separate preprocessor packet with raw-to-v3 crosswalk, text-only privacy scrub, input hashes, known masks and preserved attribution; no old rewrites.
minimum_new_data_tasks.requirements: Process raw observed text identically without annotations; preserve ordinary PIN/status wording while removing actual secrets. No gold spans/slot types/domains in feature construction. Independently review a TRAIN sample of positive/negative semantic preservation before claiming raw-text ability. Missing/lost label evidence becomes documented UNKNOWN, never flipped to improve scores. Slot tasks remain excluded.
minimum_new_data_tasks.counts: 2088 retained source rows; no new source-row count invented.

minimum_new_data_tasks.request: 32 genuinely new scenario roots,4 contrasts each=128 requested new rows,not yet collected. Separate two author perspectives with full ancestry linkage; no old heldout/paraphrase relabeling or promotion.
minimum_new_data_tasks.axes: Eight root families each for own-vs-reported/conditional promise, affirmation/first-refusal/prior-withdrawal, direct-vs-reported/negated dispute, and correction/unfinished/reference. Each root needs current alternatives with different labels under the SAME prior context, and where relevant same current wording under different observed contexts.
minimum_new_data_tasks.examples: A payment question with direct commitment vs tentative funding vs quote from another person; prior grant vs no grant with identical stop wording; disputed ownership vs describing another party dispute; revised terms vs unchanged confirmation with both targets scoped. These are root nominations, not existing labelled rows.
minimum_new_data_tasks.split: Freeze24 roots TRAIN/4 CAL/4 later parent-only heldout before fitting; whole paraphrase/template/role-switch descendants stay in their root. Union authors who share a scenario skeleton before counts. Do not expose new heldout to designer/implementer for tuning.
minimum_new_data_tasks.annotation: Seven independent binary axes plus explicit UNKNOWN, actor and target/evidence span metadata offline only. Second author/reviewer annotates without first labels or model predictions; resolve disagreements without fabricating truth. Synthetic engineering provenance stays explicit, even after two reviews.
minimum_new_data_tasks.old_packet: Keep old86 TRAIN as an optional reported seed; retain old CAL/heldout exposed diagnostics separate. Any reviewed ancestry overlap unites groups, never doubles support.

repayment_representation_followup.not_current_fit: After collection, predeclare flat pooled-context teacher vs speaker-separated teacher on identical observations/labels and optimizer budget.
repayment_representation_followup.structured_features: [E(current USER),E(previous USER or explicit absent),E(previous SYSTEM or explicit absent),presence flags]; no source-label phase, oracle actor or bank state. Separate blocks avoid directly mixing prior promises and current reports. Input information matches flat baseline; no-context is an explicit different-information diagnostic only.
repayment_representation_followup.TRAIN_controls: Group leave-out/OOF using canonical roots, own current utterance vs context-only, and shuffled within-TRAIN targets. Missing positive/negative support in a fold yields UNKNOWN/trained=false for that fold; no fictitious in-fold support. Report context-only predictability and group-level loss.
repayment_representation_followup.distillation: Only after useful fresh-head evidence; prefer TRAIN-group-out teacher targets with per-fold support masks to reduce training-family memorization. Cache TRAIN targets only; do not distill old/current CAL/heldout. Student current/context feature namespaces separate rather than one untagged concatenated bag.
repayment_representation_followup.selection: All hypotheses motivated by actual TRAIN context fingerprints; old exposed F1 is descriptive. New data/folds/calibration/evaluation frozen before results. No claimed future accuracy.
